name: IDColab
summary:
IDColab brings your design projects into your headset, so clients and teams can review design work at true scale instead of on a flat screen.

Open any project and find everything where you left it: the activity feed, discussions, blockers, the schedule, files and folders. Step into 360 panoramas and renderings, place 3D models and room scans from the IDColab app in your space, page through drawings and PDFs, and play project videos on a large screen.

Review together. Leave comments and pins on images, pan
